title: sporobolus tricholepis
intro: Sporobolus tricholepis, commonly known as Poverty Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to North America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sporobolus tricholepis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
